provenance.name: CASE_HighArousal
provenance.description: CASE dataset, high-arousal video conditions (amusement, fear).
provenance.origin: Frozen reference profile estimated in the author's PhD work and ported to DERMA.
provenance.citation: Sharma K, Castellini C, van den Broek EL, Albu-Schaeffer A, Schwenker F. A dataset of continuous affect annotations and physiological signals for emotion analysis. Scientific Data 6, 196 (2019). doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0209-0

recipe.artifact_mask: manual annotation (0.14% of samples in the target segments)

estimation.decomposition: cvxEDA (Greco et al., 2016), tau0 = 2.0 s, tau1 = 0.7 s
estimation.cvxeda_hyperparameters: alpha, gamma and delta_knot were tuned manually for each recording by expert visual inspection, independently of S.O.M.A.; the per-recording values were not preserved.
estimation.segmentation: contiguous blocks of the target conditions, segments shorter than 60 s discarded, longer segments split into chunks of at most 300 s
estimation.distribution_selection: maximum likelihood fit, family with minimum AIC
